title: Future Diary
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Loner Yukiteru Amano is pulled into a battle royale by Deus Ex Machina, the god of time and space, who gives twelve people phone diaries that predict the future; the last survivor becomes the next god (to verify). His protector is classmate Yuno Gasai, whose devotion to him turns into obsessive, murderous possessiveness (to verify).
life_message: It shows how obsession and the hunger for control destroy people, and asks what love and godhood are worth (to verify).
